scope.name: Happy Studio sidebar session groups
scope.state: light appearance, selected active session, revision-2 integration

claims.subject: Active and earlier sidebar session groups
claims.observation: Ordinary child rows form contiguous white blocks with visible outer corner rounding and separators, reproducing the same group-card silhouette after the explicit outer shell was removed.
limitations: Hover and focus states are not shown.

claims.subject: Sidebar visual-style propagation
claims.observation: The sidebar frame passes its resolved Studio style into SidebarView, but SessionsList independently resolves row style from runtime and local inputs instead of inheriting that frame decision.
claims.implementationCandidate: Propagate the resolved frame visual style through the sidebar host seam into SessionsList.
conflicts: Static Studio row overrides intend transparency, while reproduction truth shows Default-like row chrome.
limitations: The exact runtime input that diverged is not exposed in the screenshot.

claims.subject: Historical and compact row chrome
claims.observation: Row renderers compose default container/position styles before conditional Studio overrides, so surface, position radius, clipping, and divider behavior are not represented by one enforceable policy.
claims.implementationCandidate: Use a shared tested row-chrome decision and do not apply default chrome styles on Studio paths.

evidence.notes: Lossless window capture with metadata-backed 2x scale.
Receives the resolved DesktopSidebarFrame and derives Studio top-control styling from it.
Independently resolves session-row style and composes default historical-row container/position chrome.
Compact rows conditionally override individual chrome without a shared row-chrome policy.

limitations: Only light appearance and one window size are captured.
Hover, keyboard focus, search filtering, collapsed projects, and mobile states are not visible.
The exact divergent runtime style input is inferred from screenshot/source disagreement rather than logged.
conflicts: Static Studio overrides describe transparent ordinary rows, but the packaged reproduction shows Default-like contiguous card chrome.

notes: This record describes the failed reproduction and source disagreement; product acceptance remains with the parent/user loop.
